name: The Ministry of the Holy Angels
path: Angelology: The Doctrine of Spiritual Beings

objectives.text: Identify holy angels as servants God sends to help His people
Retell how the angels announced the birth of Jesus to the shepherds
Retell how the angel Gabriel brought Mary the news that she would bear Jesus
Recall that holy angels obey God's commands and praise His name
Explain from Jesus' words that angels rejoice in heaven when a sinner repents
Describe biblical accounts in which God sent angels to protect or rescue His people
Describe how angels worship God in the visions of Isaiah and Revelation
Explain how angels carried God's messages to people in Scripture using examples from both Testaments
Explain how the Lord's Prayer petition for God's will to be done on earth as in heaven points to the angels' willing obedience as a pattern for believers
Compare the worship angels offer God with the worship of the gathered church
Explain what Psalm 91 and Matthew 18 teach about God commanding angels to guard His people and how Jesus refused Satan's misuse of Psalm 91
Describe the work Scripture says angels will do at Christ's return
Trace the ministry of angels across redemptive history from the garden to the giving of the law to the early church
Interpret the angels' service to Christ at His birth, temptation, agony in Gethsemane, resurrection, and ascension
Explain from Scripture that God also uses angels as agents of His justice in judgment
Explain why the Reformed tradition forbids worshiping or praying to angels
Explain how the Westminster Larger Catechism presents angels as instruments God employs at His pleasure in the administration of His power, mercy, and justice
Analyze the argument of Hebrews 1 that the Son is superior to the angels, who are ministering spirits sent to serve the heirs of salvation
Evaluate popular beliefs about guardian angels, including praying to them and the idea that people become angels, in light of Scripture
Evaluate claims of new revelation received from angels using Paul's warning in Galatians and the sufficiency of Scripture
Construct a biblically grounded summary of the ministry of holy angels that keeps them subordinate to Christ and in service to His church

changes: Kept and reworded the real competencies (angels as God's servants, Gabriel, obedience, rejoicing over repentance, messengers, worship comparison, guarding, redemptive history, service to Christ, no worship of angels, guardian angel prayers, Hebrews 1 synthesis). Dropped filler and overlapping items (generic summary, connecting to church care, separate defend item) and the feeling-based 'apply comfort' objective, recasting it as interpreting Psalm 91 and Matthew 18. Added the shepherds' announcement, protection narratives, the Lord's Prayer petition with Heidelberg Q124 and WSC Q103, angels at Christ's return, angels as agents of justice, WLC Q19 on providence, and evaluating claimed angelic revelation. Anchored to verse-level Scripture and to confessional articles that state each doctrine (Belgic 12, WLC Q19, WCF 21.2, WLC Q105, WCF 1.6).
